entries.answer:
Is sthiti mein, jab aapko dono taraf se alag-alag jawab mil rahe hain, toh aapko ek formal tareeke se aage badhna chahiye:

1. **Formal Request Letter (Controller of Examination):** KGMU ke Controller of Examination ko ek **formal application** likhein. Usme saaf-saaf batayein ki aapne Examination Office mein sampark kiya tha aur unhone DGME se 'Allotment Letter' maanga hai, lekin DGME ke anusar wahan se sirf ek hi baar allotment letter issue hota hai aur aapke paas woh nahi hai. 
2. **Alternative Proofs (DGME):** DGME se ek **'Non-Availability Certificate'** ya 'Confirmation Letter' lene ki koshish karein, jisme yeh likha ho ki aapka allotment record kya hai aur allotment letter dobara issue nahi kiya ja sakta. Yeh document aapke claim ko majboot karega.
3. **College Administration ka Sahyog:** Apne college ke Principal ya Dean ke office mein jaakar unse request karein ki woh university ko ek **official letter** likhein. College ke paas aapke admission ke samay jama kiye gaye sabhi documents ka record hota hai, aur college ki taraf se university ko bheja gaya letter adhik prabhavi hota hai.
4. **RTI ka Upyog:** Agar phir bhi baat nahi banti, toh aap [https://kgmu.org/rti.php](https://kgmu.org/rti.php) ke madhyam se RTI file karke yeh pooch sakte hain ki "naam correction ke liye DGME allotment letter ki anivaryata (mandatory) kyun hai, jabki woh dobara issue nahi hota?" Isse university ko ek jawab dena padega.
5. **VC Office/Registrar Office:** Agar Examination Section se koi hal nahi nikal raha, toh aap **Registrar Office** ya **VC Office** (Phone: 0522-2257540) mein apni shikayat darj karwayein aur batayein ki aapko bina wajah pareshan kiya ja raha hai.

entries.question: Me High school ki Marksheet le gaya tha phir bhi wha ke babu ne bola ki ab Mark sheet sahi nhi Hoti h ..btaoo ye Koi jawab h
entries.answer:
Yeh bilkul sahi jawab nahi hai. KGMU ek established institution hai aur records mein correction ke liye niyam (rules) hote hain. Agar aapka naam 10th ki mark sheet ke anusar galat hai, toh use sahi karwana aapka adhikar hai.

Is sthiti mein aapko **"Babu" (dealing clerk) ke level se upar baat karni hogi**, kyunki aksar clerk aise jawab dekar kaam ko taal dete hain. Aap ye steps follow karein:

1. **Section Officer (SO) ya Assistant Registrar (Exam) se milein:** Examination office mein kisi clerk ki baat maan kar wapas na aayein. Wahan baithe **Section Officer (SO)** ya **Assistant Registrar (Exam)** se milein aur unhe apni samasya batayein. Unse kahein ki aapko likhit mein dein ki "naam correction kyun nahi ho sakta" aur "is baare mein KGMU ka kya niyam hai." Jab aap likhit (written) ki maang karenge, toh aksar woh sahi process batane lagte hain.
2. **Dean/Principal ka Letter:** Apne college ke Dean se ek 'Forwarding Letter' banwayein jisme saaf likha ho ki aapke college records mein aapka naam sahi hai aur university ki mark sheet mein printing mistake hai. Yeh letter lekar seedhe **Controller of Examination (COE)** ke office jayein.
3. **Registrar Office mein Shikayat:** Agar Exam section phir bhi mana karta hai, toh **Registrar Office** (Administrative Block) jayein aur wahan ek formal complaint (application) submit karein. Application ki ek photocopy par 'Received' stamp zaroor lagwayein.
4. **VC (Vice Chancellor) Office:** Agar registrar office se bhi koi hal nahi milta, toh aap VC office mein apni application de sakte hain. KGMU mein students ki academic samasyaon ke liye VC office ek valid platform hai.
5. **Helpline ka use karein:** Aap [PRO Office](https://www.kgmu.org/pro_cug.php) ya VC office ke numbers (0522-2257540) par phone karke poochein ki "Examination records mein correction ka sahi process kya hai aur kaunsa officer iske liye responsible hai?"

**Zaroori baat:** Kisi bhi clerk ki baat par bina kisi official order ke wapas na aayein. Jab tak aap kisi senior officer (SO, AR, ya COE) se nahi milte, tab tak aapka kaam aage nahi badhega.

Aapki baat bilkul sahi hai. Marksheet university (KGMU) dwara issue ki gayi hai, isliye correction ka adhikar aur zimmedari KGMU ki hi hai. College ka kaam sirf aapki application ko **verify** aur **forward** karna hota hai.

Madam ne jo kaha, uska matlab shayad yeh hai ki "College ke record mein check karwao aur wahan se correction ke liye document process karwao." Aksar university seedhe student se application lene ke bajaye college ke through process karwati hai.

**Ab aapko ye strategy apnaani chahiye:**

1. **College se "Correction Recommendation" Letter lein:** Moti Lal Nehru Medical College (MLNMC) ke **Principal office** jayein. Unhe batayein ki aapne KGMU se baat ki hai aur unhone kaha hai ki college se process hoga. Principal office se ek letter banwayein jisme likha ho:
   *   "Student ka sahi naam [Sahi Naam] hai jo ki unke 10th certificate aur admission records mein darj hai."
   *   "University dwara issue ki gayi marksheet mein naam mein printing error hai."
   *   "College ise verify karta hai aur correction ke liye anushansa (recommendation) karta hai."

2. **KGMU Exam Section mein "Forwarding" ka mahatva:** Jab aap college ka yeh official letter lekar KGMU Exam Section jayenge, toh wahan ke clerk ya officer ke liye aapko mana karna mushkil hoga. Yeh letter proof hai ki college aapke naam ko sahi maanta hai.

3. **Controller of Examination (COE) se milne ki koshish karein:** Agar wahan ka koi bhi clerk (babu) phir bhi bole ki "nahi hoga," toh seedhe **Controller of Examination (COE)** ke chamber mein jayein. Unhe batayein:
   *   "Sir, maine college se verification letter le liya hai."
   *   "Main 10th ki mark sheet le aaya hoon."
   *   "Main ek student hoon aur mujhe career mein dikkat aa rahi hai, kripya meri file process karwayein."

4. **Ek Last Option:** Agar College aur KGMU dono ek-dusre par daal rahe hain, toh aap **UP Medical Education Department (DGME)** ki website par online shikayat (Grievance) darj karein. Jab wahan se inquiry aati hai, toh University ko turant process karna padta hai.

**Pro Tip:** Jab aap KGMU jayein, toh apni 10th ki mark sheet ki photo copy, college ka forwarding letter, aur apni purani marksheet ki copy zaroor le jayein. Wahan jakar kisi se ladne ke bajaye, sirf ye kahein ki "Mujhe bataiye ki meri file kis officer ke paas approve hogi."

entries.answer:

Jab university aur DGME ek-dusre par zimmedari daal rahe hain, toh aapko **"Systematic Grievance"** ka rasta apnana hoga:

1. **DGME Lucknow (Head Office) mein Shikayat:** DGME ke office (Jawahar Bhawan, Lucknow) jayein aur wahan ke **Director Medical Education** ko ek application dein. Unhe batayein ki:
   * "KGMU marksheet mein naam correction ke liye aapka record chahiye."
   * "KGMU ke COE ne kaha hai ki jab tak DGME sahi nahi karega, hum nahi karenge."
   * Unse ek **'Corrected Allotment Letter'** ya **'Verification Letter'** ki maang karein jisme aapka sahi naam likha ho.

2. **Jan Sunwai (UP CM Portal):** Yeh sabse prabhavi (effective) tareeka hai. [jansunwai.up.nic.in](https://jansunwai.up.nic.in) par apni shikayat online darj karein. 
   * Shikayat mein likhein: "Main MBBS student hoon, meri marksheet mein naam galat hai. KGMU Exam cell aur DGME office dono ek-dusre par tal rahe hain, jis karan mera bhavishya prabhavit ho raha hai."
   * Jab aap **Jan Sunwai** par complaint daalte hain, toh uska jawab dena university aur DGME dono ki majboori ho jaati hai kyunki yeh report seedhe CM office/Chief Secretary ko jaati hai.

3. **College ka "Record Verification" Document:** Apne college se ek **"Admission Record Verification"** letter lein jisme saaf likha ho ki aapne jab admission liya tha, tab aapke documents (10th marksheet) mein naam kya tha. Yeh dikhata hai ki galti University/DGME ki taraf se hui hai, na ki aapki.

4. **Legal Notice (Last Resort):** Agar Jan Sunwai se bhi 15-20 din mein koi hal na nikle, toh aap kisi advocate ke madhyam se KGMU aur DGME dono ko ek **Legal Notice** bhej sakte hain. Aksar legal notice milte hi university administration file ko process karne lagti hai kyunki woh court case se bachna chahte hain.

**Meri Salah:** 
Abhi turant **Jansunwai Portal** par shikayat darj karein. Ismein aapko kisi se ladna nahi padega aur aapka kaam official channel se ho jayega. Wahan jo 'Complaint ID' mile, use sambhal kar rakhein.

2.  **Doctor ke Room mein:** Jab aapki mummy ka number aaye, toh aap unke saath doctor ke room mein ja sakte hain kyunki wo padhi-likhi nahi hain aur unhe apni takleef samjhane ya doctor ki baat samajhne mein aapki madad ki zaroorat hogi.
3.  **Anumati (Permission):** Room mein jaane se pehle bahar khade staff ya nurse se vinamra hokar keh dein ki, *"Meri mummy padhi-likhi nahi hain aur apni takleef theek se nahi bata payengi, kya main unke saath andar ja sakta hoon?"* Aise mamlon mein staff aksar sahmat ho jate hain.
4.  **Zaroori Documents:** Mummy ka Aadhaar card, New OPD ka purana parcha, aur doctor ki referral slip zaroor saath rakhein.

**Ek Salah:** Agar aapke saath koi female rishtedaar (jaise behen, chachi, ya koi aur) ja sakein, toh behtar hoga. Lekin agar koi nahi hai, toh aap bilkul befikr hokar jayein, bas doctor aur staff se vinamra rahein. Hospital mein mareez ki madad ke liye attendants ko jana allow hota hai agar mareez ko zarurat ho.
